svg.title: Delegation Board
svg.desc: A3 landscape delegation board: the seven levels of delegation, a decision-area grid with a review column, guardrails, and next steps.
svg.text: Make decision rights explicit: for each area, agree how much the team decides, and move it up over time.
Lead the Organisation · Inspired by Management 3.0 (Jurgen Appelo) · Seven Levels of Delegation
FROM LEADER DECIDES TO TEAM DECIDES
I ask you, then I decide
You decide; no need to tell me
MARK TODAY'S LEVEL · ARROW TO WHERE WE'RE HEADING
e.g. How we plan our work
e.g. Spending up to a limit
e.g. budget limits, legal and policy rules, security standards
Agreed with the team, not just announced
Posted where everyone can see it
One area moves up a level next
Review the board every few months
“Which decisions could the team make without us?”
“What would we need to trust to move this up one level?”
Lead the Organisation · Outcomes Over Output · Evidence, Not Opinion
